entries.label: CM1 1악장 기름 부음 (45.5s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 45 seconds, never stopping or restarting: a cinematic chamber-orchestra piece of quiet wonder. A slow, noble four-note anointing theme in E minor runs through all of it; every change grows out of what is already playing. 0–8 s: a solo cello alone plays the theme very softly, intimate and close, like a candle in a dark room, with a faint low string pedal on E. At about 8 s a harp joins with slow rippling figures like water in late-afternoon light, the cello answering. At about 14 s everything thins to one suspended high violin note with faint glassy harmonics, still and expectant, for five seconds. At about 19.5 s near silence for one breath. At 20.3 s a radiant warm bloom: full strings, soft French horns and a wordless choir state the theme in E major, the fullest moment of the movement around 21.5 s, then easing by 23.5 s. At about 23.5 s a soft wooden shepherd's flute takes the theme over warm low strings, a hillside at sunset, quiet under a spoken voice; at about 29 s the strings rise warmly and gently for four seconds, like oil poured out, then settle. At about 36 s it turns solemn and hushed: low strings and one soft horn, reverent. At about 40 s the cello takes the theme back over the harp, a gentle lift at 42 s, and at 44 s the harmony darkens toward minor, as if continuing. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, spacious, mid-range kept clear for a voice, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM1

entries.label: CM2 2악장 길과 십자가 (55s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 55 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme in E minor). 0–7 s: the color turns cold and grand: low brass and low strings in minor with a deep, soft frame-drum pulse, stern and imperial, wind on stone walls. At about 7 s warmth returns: a steady walking low-string ostinato with a softly plucked oud, a band of men on a dusty road at golden hour, and the solo cello sings the theme above it, quiet under a spoken voice. At about 11 s one warm, bright major chord blooms for two seconds, then the walk goes on. At about 15 s the harmony darkens and the walking slows and hesitates, the theme in minor, unease growing. At about 23 s tension: quick string tremolo and a dissonant viola cry, urgent, for four seconds. At about 27 s it empties to a solo cello and one faint high glassy note, alone at dusk, the first star. At about 32 s intimate and ancient: a harp and a solo viola in minor, lamplight on an old scroll, very quiet under a voice. At about 43 s grave darkness: one low string drone and a slow, sparse lament on solo cello, bare, no warmth. At about 47.5 s it sinks lower and darker, almost silent. At about 52 s only a single warm low note remains, held, like an ember, fading to the end. Slow tempo, mid-range kept clear for a voice, no synths.
entries.name: CM2

entries.label: CM3 3악장 이미 적힌 길 (52s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 52 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme in E minor). 0–1 s from near silence: a soft celesta spark and a harp note, like a lamp catching flame. From about 1 s a solo violin sings the theme as an ancient psalm-lament over a quiet low string pad and a plucked lyre, sorrowful, very quiet under a spoken voice. At about 5.4 s a soft glassy shimmer of high strings swells for two seconds and settles; at about 11.6 s the same shimmer once more. At about 16.5 s dry and sparse: a few low pizzicato notes, stark daylight, waiting. At about 22.4 s warmth and resolve: strings begin to move forward gently, hopeful, the cello carrying the theme. At about 27 s luminous and airy: high strings, a soft wordless choir and slow descending harp, a pale gentle light coming down, tender and still, quiet under a voice, for ten seconds. At about 37.5 s it goes cold and bare: one low drone only. At about 40 s, with no voice, one grave, aching full string chord swells alone for two seconds, the most sorrowful moment, then fades to a hush. At about 42 s dawn: the strings rise slowly and gently into E major with a soft choir hum, the first warm light, then warm and calm under a voice to the end. Slow tempo, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM3

entries.label: CM4 4악장 한 분에게 (32s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 32 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme, now in E major). It opens on warm sustained strings. At about 0.4 s a French horn plays the first phrase of the theme, rising; at about 2.8 s the phrase again, a step higher, with more strings; at about 5.2 s a third time, higher still, with a soft choir: three rising steps. From about 7.4 s everything gathers and builds steadily. At about 9.7 s a radiant, full swell: full orchestra and wordless choir state the theme in E major, like the sun rising, the fullest and brightest moment of the whole score around 10.5 s. At about 11.6 s it settles into peace: solo cello and harp over warm sustained strings, candlelight and morning, quiet under a spoken voice. At about 18.8 s tender and close. At about 24.6 s the strings softly state the theme one last time. At about 27 s a breath of near silence, then at about 27.6 s one long, warm open E major chord that decays slowly to silence by the end. Slow tempo, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM4
